records.text: "This is a shady company," warned Alan Klinj (Student Loan Justice founder; name spelling unverified), founder of Student Loan Justice, a consumer protection group. He continues, quote, "Charlie Kirk promoted fiscal responsibility. It's very ironic that his group would be working with a company that has been caught deceiving investors," end quote.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
